cohort: 12,472 women who delivered in nine health facilities in Mali and Benin in 2014, 2015, and 2016
finding: High cesarean section rates were found in both Mali and Benin, particularly among low-risk women and those with a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: C-section rates in women who had undergone a previous c-section were especially high in both countries (84.0% in Mali; 82.5% in Benin).
